title: 第14章 老鳏夫赵丁
novel_title: 丰腴小村妇，大佬们跪求嫁给他(锦绣钱澄)
content_zh: 刘宇宁知道，这个堂弟想去的不是医院，是热闹的镇上。张家人，从没带他去过镇上。从前自己还在家，背着他去过几回。几年不见，他果然一副衰败之相。“又没病，去什么医院，不用去。”张国海在门口，脸拉了下来。“吃饭满满一大碗，比我还能，该去医院的人是我才对，咳咳咳！”张国海扶着自己的腰，昨天让巴儿姐踹了几脚，现在还疼，可是他不敢吭声。“钱多得没地方花吗？好端端去什么医院！”范金花从火房出来，准备剁猪菜，听到张国海说要去医院，搭了一句。张国海立马不吭声。但张永福想去。“哥，你带我去吧，我要去。这个家没人管我，还是你对我最好。”刘宇宁看看张国海，又看看剁猪菜的范金花。“哥，求你了。这个家，没人在乎我的死活。”张永福摇着刘宇宁的手臂，语气都是哀求。“好，明天刚好是圩日，我抽个空，带你去一趟。”刘宇宁心一软，答应了。“哥，还是你最好！”张永福很高兴，又可以去热闹的镇上看一看。……徐喜弟洗漱完，从后院进屋，刘宇宁已经走了。“巴儿姐呢？”屋里没见那个身影，她就忍不住揪心。李二拐那个狗东西，这两天还在盯着巴儿姐不放。“一大早吃完饭就出去了。”范金花不咸不淡应了一句。“怎么不管管她？”徐喜弟咬着牙，也顾不上吃饭，就匆匆出了门。到了刘二拐家，大门紧闭。她心下暗叫不妙。又去了溪边，没见人。徐喜弟着急忙慌把村里能去的地方，都走了一遍，始终不见人影。她眼皮一阵猛跳，是不是又给李二拐哄上山去了！刘德怀家和李二拐家是邻居，分礼只怕少不了给他送一份。有了那些吃的，用来哄骗巴儿姐简直不要太容易。上山，能去的地方可就太多了。她又往上回捉李二拐的地方找去，还是没人。要紧了！徐喜弟找不到人，只能先往回赶，找了这么久，说不定岔过了，人已经回家也不一定。想到这，她又匆匆往回赶。才回到村口，正好看到李二拐，一跛一跛地从旧牛棚出来。那是以前公社盖的牛棚，后来分地，已经废弃了几年。看到李二拐，徐喜弟想也不想，就从地上扯了一根柴棍冲上去。“李二拐，巴儿姐呢？”李二拐看到气势汹汹的徐喜弟，先是捂着自己的屁股，看她只有一个人，面目很快又变得凶恶。“问我找她？我怎么她了？”他说着，上下打量着徐喜弟，这个丫头几条村都找不到比她更好看的。然后竟咽了咽口水，手还理了理裤裆。徐喜弟看他意淫自己，挥着棍子就打出去。李二拐用手挡了一下，才没被崩到脸，但是很疼。“你个疯女人！我干什么了你就打我！”一边骂，一边指着牛棚，“你自己上去看看，自己上去看看，跟我有没有关系！”什么？巴儿姐在牛棚？李二拐得手了？“他妈的，你个狗东西！”徐喜弟咒骂一声，也不知道哪里来的力气，上去揪着李二拐的衣领，就把他提溜上。然后拖着他往牛棚走。才靠近牛棚，就听见里面传来巴儿姐的声音。“阿巴巴……”还有一个男人的声音，“别叫啊，等下有人来了！”是村里那个老鳏夫赵丁，才丧妻没多久，儿女去年跟人去了深市，家里还有一个25岁没娶妻的儿子。哼！手里的李二拐哼了一声。他没往下说，但意思很明显，全村想脱巴儿姐衣服的汉子，多的是。徐喜弟一愣，松开李二拐，然后咬着牙捏紧棍子就冲进去。才冲进去，她就傻了眼。两人的衣服用来铺地，巴儿姐两手撑着，跪在衣服上。赵丁扎着马步，两手扶住腰。徐喜弟是气愤没错，但她也才十八岁，这样的场面也是头回见。“赵，赵丁，你在干什么！”她被惊得连话都说不利索了。赵丁回头看了一眼，见是徐喜弟这个小丫头片子，也没理会，只管忙自己的。徐喜弟知道他没把自己放在眼里，气得一棍子打了上去。“嘶！”赵丁转头一个恶狠狠的眼神，松开手转身就要来掐徐喜弟的脖子。跟在后面看热闹的李二拐，被这架势吓软了腿。怕以后自己被赵丁收拾，连忙开口解释，“是她非要拉着我来的，我~我打不过她。”赵丁真没把徐喜弟当回事，更是看都不看李二拐一眼。李二拐可不想淌这个混水，立马转身屁滚尿流跑了。“赵丁，你一把年纪了，欺负一个残疾人，我要去报公安！让你吃牢饭！”徐喜弟用棍子指着赵丁，对方看她手里有家伙，顿了顿。“你去报！我现在就去烧你家房子，张国海就是个废物！一家子废物！”徐喜弟一听对方要上家里烧房子，还真被唬住了。赵丁看她愣住，从地上抽出自己的裤子，不紧不慢穿上。“你一个外姓的小丫头片子，少管闲事。等张永福一死，你也要改嫁的，管这一家子废物做什么？”他一边穿衣服，一边斜着眼看徐喜弟。她还真被他的一番话噎住了，是啊，她生完孩子就要走得远远的，干嘛招惹这些糟心事。可是想想又不对，张国海家给人欺负成这样，她孩子要留在这样的人家怎么行……正犹豫，要不要挥棍子打几下先出一口恶气，又担心自己不是他的对手，要吃亏。忽然，一个身影快速冲进来，长腿一蹬，赵丁肚子上吃了满满一脚，仰翻在地。他还没反应过来，裤袋就被人抽走了，三下五除二，两手反剪到后背，然后用裤袋结结实实捆上。“喜弟，你没事吧？”刘宇宁捆完人，第一时间先转头关切徐喜弟。徐喜弟已经呆了。“巴巴，阿巴！”巴儿姐倒是喃了两声，红着脸，捡起衣服就胡乱往身上套。刘宇宁也不敢去看那对奶白的大雪子，别着头，“喜弟，先给月梅穿上衣服。”全村，只有刘宇宁一个人，叫巴儿姐的名字。“哦~哦~”徐喜弟这才反应过来，上去帮巴儿姐穿衣服。
content_en: Liu Yuning knew that this cousin wanted to go not to the hospital, but to the lively town.The Zhang family never took him to town.I used to be at home and carried him there a few times.After not seeing him for several years, he really looked like he was in decline."I'm not sick. There's no need to go to any hospital." Zhang Guohai was at the door, his face downcast."You have a big bowl full of food. You are better than me. I am the one who should go to the hospital, cough, cough, cough!" Zhang Guohai held his waist. He was kicked a few times by Sister Ba'er yesterday. It still hurts, but he did not dare to say a word."You have so much money that you don't have anywhere to spend it? Why don't you go to the hospital?" Fan Jinhua came out of the fire room and was about to chop pork and vegetables. She heard Zhang Guohai say that he was going to the hospital and said something to her.Zhang Guohai immediately fell silent.But Zhang Yongfu wanted to go."Brother, take me there, I want to go. No one in this family cares about me, but you are the best to me." Liu Yuning looked at Zhang Guohai and then at Fan Jinhua, who was chopping pork and vegetables."Brother, please. No one in this family cares about my life or death." Zhang Yongfu shook Liu Yuning's arm, his tone pleading."Okay, tomorrow happens to be the fair day, I will take some time to take you there." Liu Yuning softened his heart and agreed."Brother, you are the best!" Zhang Yongfu was very happy to go to the lively town again....Xu Xidi finished washing and entered the house from the backyard. Liu Yuning had already left."Where's Sister Ba'er?" She couldn't help but worry when she didn't see that figure in the room.That bitch Li Erguai has been staring at Sister Ba'er for the past two days."I went out after eating early in the morning." Fan Jinhua responded calmly."Why don't you care about her?" Xu Xidi gritted his teeth and hurried out the door without caring about eating.When they arrived at Liu Erguai's house, the door was closed.She secretly screamed that something was wrong.Went to the stream again, but saw no one.Xu Xidi hurriedly walked to all the places he could go in the village, but no one was there.Her eyelids twitched. Was Li Erguai coaxing her up the mountain again?Liu Dehuai's family and Li Erguai's family are neighbors, so I'm afraid giving him a gift is indispensable.With all that food, it's not easy to coax Sister Ba'er.There are so many places to go up the mountain.She went back to the place where she had caught Li Erguai, but there was still no one there.It's important!Xu Xidi couldn't find anyone, so he had to rush back first. After searching for so long, he might have passed by, or he might have gone home.Thinking of this, she hurried back.Just when we returned to the village entrance, we happened to see Li Erguai limping out of the old cowshed.It was a cowshed built by the commune in the past. The land was later divided and has been abandoned for several years.Seeing Li Erguai, Xu Xidi pulled a stick from the ground and rushed forward without thinking."Li Erguai, where is Sister Ba'er?" When Li Erguai saw the aggressive Xu Xidi, he first covered his butt. Seeing that she was alone, his expression quickly turned ferocious."Asking me to find her? What happened to me?" He said, looking Xu Xidi up and down. This girl could not be found in several villages who was more beautiful than her.Then he actually swallowed and adjusted his crotch with his hands.Xu Xidi saw that he was lusting after him, so he beat him out with a stick.Li Erguai blocked it with his hand to avoid being hit in the face, but it was very painful."You crazy woman! Hit me if I do anything!" He scolded and pointed at the bullpen, "Go up and see for yourself, go up and see for yourself, if it has anything to do with me!" What?Sister Ba'er is in the bullpen?Did Li Erguai succeed?"Damn it, you piece of shit!" Xu Xidi cursed, and he didn't know where he got the strength to grab Li Erguai's collar and lift him up.Then dragged him to the bullpen.As soon as I got close to the cowshed, I heard Sister Ba'er's voice coming from inside."Ababa..." There was also a man's voice, "Don't scream, someone will come later!" It was Zhao Ding, the old widower in the village. He had just lost his wife not long ago. His children went to Shenzhen City with someone last year. There is also a 25-year-old son at home who is not married.snort!Li Erguai in his hand snorted.He didn't say anything further, but the meaning was obvious. There were many men in the village who wanted to take off Sister Ba'er's clothes.Xu Xidi was stunned, let go of Li Erguai, then gritted his teeth and squeezed the stick tightly before rushing in.As soon as she rushed in, she was dumbfounded.The clothes of the two people were used to spread the floor. Sister Ba'er held her hands and knelt on the clothes.Zhao Ding stepped forward and held his waist with both hands.It was true that Xu Xidi was angry, but she was only eighteen years old, and this was the first time she had seen such a scene."Zhao, Zhao Ding, what are you doing!" She was so shocked that she couldn't even speak clearly.Zhao Ding looked back and saw that it was Xu Xidi, a little girl. He ignored her and just went about his own business.Xu Xidi knew that he didn't take her seriously, so he was so angry that he hit him with a stick."Hiss!" Zhao Ding turned his head with a vicious look, let go of his hand and turned around to pinch Xu Xidi's neck.Li Erguai, who was following behind to watch the excitement, was frightened by this posture and his legs weakened.Afraid that he would be dealt with by Zhao Ding in the future, he quickly explained, "She insisted on dragging me here. I~I can't beat her." Zhao Ding really didn't take Xu Xidi seriously, and he didn't even look at Li Erguai.Li Erguai didn't want to get into trouble, so he immediately turned around and ran away."Zhao Ding, you are too old to bully a disabled person. I am going to report it to the police! You will go to jail!" Xu Xidi pointed at Zhao Ding with a stick. The other party paused when he saw that she had a dick in her hand."Go report it! I will burn down your house right now. Zhang Guohai is a waste! The whole family is a waste!" Xu Xidi was really frightened when he heard that the other party was going to burn the house at home.Zhao Ding saw her stunned, took out his pants from the ground, and put them on slowly."You're a little girl with a foreign surname. Stop meddling in other people's business. Once Zhang Yongfu dies, you will remarry. Why do you care about this useless family?" He looked sideways at Xu Xidi while getting dressed.She was really choked by his words. Yes, she would go far away after giving birth, so why did she cause such trouble?But it didn't feel right to think about it. Zhang Guohai's family was bullied like this. How could her child stay in such a family? She was hesitating whether to hit her with a stick a few times to vent her anger, but she was also worried that she was no match for him and would suffer a loss.Suddenly, a figure rushed in quickly, kicked his long legs, and Zhao Ding got a kick in his stomach and fell to the ground.Before he could react, his trouser pockets were pulled out, his hands were cut behind his back, and then he was tied tightly with his trouser pockets."Xidi, are you okay?" After Liu Yuning tied up the people, he immediately turned to show concern for Xu Xidi.Xu Xidi was already stunned."Baba, Aba!" Sister Ba'er murmured twice, blushing, picking up her clothes and putting them on randomly.Liu Yuning did not dare to look at the pair of milky-white snowflakes. He turned his head away and said, "Brother Xi, put some clothes on Yuemei first." Liu Yuning was the only one in the village who called Sister Baer's name."Oh~oh~" Xu Xidi finally realized and went up to help Sister Ba'er get dressed.
